40801.meaning2: having repaired, having restored, having mended

examples.text: katamehi catūhi? naṭṭhaṃ na gavesanti, jiṇṇaṃ na paṭisaṅkharonti, aparimitapānabhojanā honti, dussīlaṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ādhipacce ṭhapenti. yāni kānici, bhikkhave, kulāni bhogesu mahattaṃ pattāni na ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni imehi catūhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.

40804.meaning1: reflecting; carefully considering; with due consideration

examples.text: bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hohi. paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreyyāsi

40807.meaning1: power of careful consideration; power of reflection

examples.text: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ.

40808.meaningLit: discourse on the power of careful consideration

40809.meaning1: observing reflectively; contemplating with careful consideration

40810.commentary: (NIDD1a) paṭisaṅkhāyoniso'ti upāyena pathena paṭisaṅkhāya ñatvā, paccavekkhitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti, anāgataṃ rūpaṃ n'ābhinandati, paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
so taṃ paṭisaṅkhāya piveyya, nappaṭinissajjeyya. tassa taṃ pivato'hi kho nacchādeyya vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi, pivitvā ca pana sukhī assa.

40811.meaning2: with reflection, with judgement, with consideration

examples.text: anāpatti kattha demā'ti pucchiyamāno yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṅkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethā'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājagahaṃ paṭisaṅkhārāpeti rañño pajjotassa āsaṅkamāno.

40814.construction:
pati + saṃ + √kar > khar > khār + *a + ika
paṭisaṅkhāra + ika

examples.text: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto anattamano ahosi, kathañ'hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpad'atthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī'ti!

katamā c'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, suññam'idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā'ti. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti.
so iti paṭisañcikkhati yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
attabyābādhāya saṃvattatī'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati, parabyābādhāya saṃvattatī'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati
it'iha me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato app'ossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāya.
so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhiṃ, sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.

40819.meaning1: should be reflected; should be considered; should be discerned (by)

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ, ahaṃ kho imaṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharāmi, tassa me imaṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati na upaṭṭhāti

40820.meaning1: revived; resurrected; come back to life

examples.text: acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnako'va kālaṅ'kato, sv'āyaṃ paṭisañjīvito'ti. iminā kho evaṃ, pāpima, pariyāyena āyasmato sañjīvassa sañjīvo't'eva samaññā udapādi.

40821.synonym: diṭṭha, disa, paccatthika, paccāmitta, paṭisūra, paravādī, veripuggala, sattar, sattu

40822.meaning1: inimical state; fact of being opposed

40823.meaning1: is hospitable; receives in a friendly manner (with)
40823.commentary: (DNa) atītena paṭisantharatī'ti sahāye āgate hiyyo vā pare vā na āgato'si, amhākaṃ imasmiṃ vāre sassaṃ ativiya nipphannaṃ, bahūni sāli-yava-bīj'ādīni ṭhapetvā maggaṃ olokentā nisīdimha, ajja pana sabbaṃ khīṇan'ti evaṃ atītena saṅgaṇhā'ti. anāgatenā'ti imasmiṃ vāre amhākaṃ sassaṃ manāpaṃ bhavissati, phalabhārabharitā sāli-ādayo, sassasaṅgahe kate tumhākaṃ saṅgahaṃ kātuṃ samatthā bhavissāmā'ti evaṃ anāgatena saṅgaṇhā'ti.

examples.text: catūhi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo. atītena paṭisantharati, anāgatena paṭisantharati, niratthakena saṅgaṇhāti, paccuppannesu kiccesu byasanaṃ dasseti. imehi kho, gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.
ath'etaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ upādāya evam'avocumhā'ti
satthugaru dhammagaru, saṅghe ca tibbagāravo, appamādagaru bhikkhu, paṭisanthāragāravo, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike'ti.

40827.meaning1: fact of having respect for hospitality; fact of giving weight to friendly reception

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

40828.meaning1: one should be cordial by nature; one should have a friendly disposition

examples.text: mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.
yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanass'ānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā.

40836.meaning1: rebirth-linking; connection to the next existence

examples.text: paṭisandhiṃ na passāmi, vicinanto bhave ahaṃ, nirūpadhi vippamutto, upasanto carām'ahaṃ.

atīte kururaṭṭhe indapattanagare dhanañcaye rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā anupubbena viññutaṃ patto takkasilāyaṃ sippāni uggahetvā pitarā uparajje patiṭṭhāpito aparabhāge pitu accayena rajjaṃ patvā dasa rājadhamme akopento kurudhamme vattittha. kurudhammo nāma pañcasīlāni, tāni bodhisatto parisuddhāni katvā rakkhi.

40839.meaning1: moment of linking to another life

40842.meaning1: danger of rebirth-linking; peril of connection to the next existence

40843.meaning1: due to linking to another life

examples.text: petalokan'ti pettivisayaṃ, khuppipās'ādi-bhedaṃ pet'attabhāvan'ti attho. agaman'ti paṭisandhivasena upagacchiṃ upapajjiṃ. punappunan'ti apar'āparaṃ.

40844.meaning1: consciousness which links one to another life

40845.meaning2: having an equal; with a counterpart

examples.text: sabbadisāsu sīhavilokanaṃ viloketvā attanā paṭisamaṃ kañci sattaṃ adisvā aggo'ham'asmi lokassā'ti evaṃ sīhanādanadanam'pi

40846.meaning1: penetrating insight (into); analytical knowledge (of); discriminating understanding (of)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati.
upakaṭṭhāya pavāraṇāya sabb'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu

40848.meaning1: attained penetrating insight; having discriminative understanding
40848.commentary: (ANa) paṭisambhidāpattānan'ti catasso paṭisambhidā patvā ṭhitānaṃ mahākoṭṭhitatthero aggo'ti dasseti. ayaṃ hi thero attano paṭisambhidāsu ciṇṇavasibhāvena abhiññāte abhiññāte mahāsāvake upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanto'pi dasabalaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanto'pi paṭisambhidāsu'y'eva pañhaṃ pucchati. iti iminā ciṇṇavasibhāvena paṭisambhidāpattānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisambhidāpattānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākoṭṭhito'ti.

40850.meaningLit: path to penetrating insight; way to analytical knowledge

examples.text: yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṃ [arahattappattaṃ paṭi. ma. 2.1 paṭisambhidāmagge'pi] byākaroti, sabbo so catūhi maggehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

40851.meaning1: communicates happily; engages in friendly conversation (with)
40851.meaning2: talks to in a friendly manner; exchanges greetings
40851.commentary: (DNa) paṭisammodatī'ti saṃsandati kho te'ti-ādīni vadanto bhagavā sammodati, pañcasikho paṭisammodati. gāthā ca bhāsanto pañcasikho sammodati, bhagavā paṭisammodati.

examples.text: atha kho sakkassa devānam'indassa etadahosi, paṭisammodati pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto bhagavatā, bhagavā ca pañcasikhenā'ti.

40852.meaning1: talking in a friendly manner (with); exchanging greetings
40852.meaning2: talking in a friendly manner; greeting

examples.text: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.

40853.meaning2: talked in a friendly manner; exchanged greetings

40854.meaning2: talked in a friendly manner; exchanged greetings

40855.meaning2: to talk to in a friendly manner; to speak hospitably; to exchange greetings (with)

40856.meaning2: having talked in a friendly manner; having exchanged greetings

examples.text: atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito, ayaṃ vo mam'accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti

40858.commentary: (MNa) kiṃ paṭisaraṇan'ti etesaṃ kiṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, kiṃ etāni paṭisarantī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, āvuso, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ, kiṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, ko ca nesaṃ gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhotī'ti?
manassa pana, bho gotama, kiṃ paṭisaraṇan'ti? manassa kho, brāhmaṇa, sati paṭisaraṇan'ti. satiyā pana, bho gotama, kiṃ paṭisaraṇan'ti? satiyā kho, brāhmaṇa, vimutti paṭisaraṇan'ti.

40860.commentary: (SNa) paṭisallāṇe'ti idaṃ bhagavā te bhikkhū kāyavivekena parihāyante disvā kāyavivekaṃ labhantānaṃ imesaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ phātiṃ gamissatī'ti ñatvā āha.

examples.text: paṭisallāṇe, bhikkhave, yogam'āpajjatha. paṭisallīṇo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.

paṭisaṅkhā yoniso sen'āsanaṃ paṭisevati, yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāva'd'eva utu-parissaya-vinodana-paṭisallāna-ārām'atthaṃ
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ñātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. atha kho bhagavā rahogato paṭisallāno imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ abhāsi

40865.meaning1: devoted to solitude; pleased with seclusion

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

40866.meaning1: suitable for seclusion; ideal for isolation

examples.text: yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti

40870.meaning1: enjoying privacy; taking pleasure in solitude

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

40871.meaning1: for the purpose of enjoying solitude
40871.construction:
paṭisallāna + ārāma + attha + aṃ
paṭisallānārāmattha + aṃ
40871.commentary: (VISM) utuparissaya-vinodana-paṭisallān'ārām'atthan'ti parisahan'aṭṭhena utu'y'eva utuparissayo. utuparissayassa vinodan'atthañ'ca paṭisallān'ārām'atthañ'ca. yo sarīr'ābādha-cittavikkhepa-karo asappāyo utu sen'āsanapaṭisevanena vinodetabbo hoti, tassa vinodan'atthaṃ ekībhāvasukh'atthañ'cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. kāmañ'ca sītapaṭighāt'ādināva utuparissaya-vinodanaṃ vuttam'eva.

examples.text: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso sen'āsanaṃ paṭisevāmi yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-siriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāva'd'eva utuparissaya-vinodanaṃ paṭisallān'ārām'atthaṃ

40872.meaning2: was in seclusion; was in solitude

40873.meaning1: to go into solitude; to withdraw into seclusion (for)
40873.commentary: (SNa) paṭisallīyitun'ti… paṭisallīyituṃ nilīyituṃ eko'va hutvā viharituṃ icchāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisalliyituṃ. n'amhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.

40874.meaning1: secluded; retired; withdrawn into seclusion; (comm) hidden in solitude

examples.text: paṭisallāṇe, bhikkhave, yogam'āpajjatha. paṭisallīṇo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

40875.meaning1: secluded; retired; withdrawn into seclusion; (comm) hidden in solitude

examples.text: idha mayhaṃ, āvuso, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, ariyo tuṇhībhāvo, ariyo tuṇhībhāvo'ti vuccati.
atha kho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi

40876.meaning1: goes into solitude; withdraws into seclusion; retreats (for)

examples.text: sutaṃ kho pana m'etaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, yo vassike cattāro māse paṭisallīyati, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so brahmānaṃ passati brahmunā sākaccheti brahmunā sallapati brahmunā mantetī'ti.

40877.meaning1: going into seclusion; withdrawing into solitude; (comm) going to lie down
40877.commentary: (VINa) dvāraṃ vivaritvā nipannavatthumhi divā paṭisallīyantenā'ti divā nipajjantena.

examples.text: anāpatti, bhikkhave, tassa bhikkhuno. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, divā paṭisallīyantena dvāraṃ saṃvaritvā paṭisallīyitun'ti.

40878.meaning1: went into solitude; withdrew into seclusion; retreated (for)

examples.text: atha kho, bho, mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ sandhāgāraṃ kārāpetvā vassike cattāro māse paṭisallīyi, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyi, n'āssudha koci upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena bhatt'ābhihārena.

40879.meaning1: to go into solitude; to withdraw into seclusion; to go on retreat (for)
40879.commentary: (SNa) icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyitun'ti ahaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaṃ aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ nilīyituṃ eko'va hutvā viharituṃ icchāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ. n'āmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.

40881.meaning1: who is self-effacing; who is austere with oneself

examples.text: na ākappasampanno hoti na vattasampanno, na bahussuto hoti na sutadharo, na paṭisallekhitā hoti na paṭisallān'ārāmo, na kalyāṇavāco hoti na kalyāṇavākkaraṇo, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu abhāvanīyo hoti.

40884.meaning2: having fastened together; having strapped together

40885.meaning1: (of an argument) would start; would begin; would engage (in)

examples.text: saccan'ti so brāhmaṇo kiṃ vadeyya, musā'ti vā so vivadetha kena, yasmiṃ samaṃ visamaṃ vā'pi n'atthi, sa kena vādaṃ paṭisaṃyujeyya.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

40888.commentary: (VIN 2.6.4) paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma yo koci itthī vā puriso vā ārāmaṃ ārām'ūpacāraṃ āgantvā āroceti, itthan'nāmassa, bhante, khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā āharissantī'ti.

examples.text: yāguyā paṭisaṃvidite, tassā parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma. bhattena paṭisaṃvidite, tassa parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma.

anāpatti paṭisaṃvidite, na khattiyo hoti, na khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto hoti, rājā sayanigharā nikkhanto hoti, mah'esī sayanigharā nikkhantā hoti, ubho vā nikkhantā honti, na sayanighare, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

40889.commentary: (VIN 2.6.4) paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma yo koci itthī vā puriso vā ārāmaṃ ārām'ūpacāraṃ āgantvā āroceti, itthan'nāmassa, bhante, khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā āharissantī'ti.

examples.text: yāguyā paṭisaṃvidite, tassā parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma. bhattena paṭisaṃvidite, tassa parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma.
rūpappaṭisaṃvedī'ti nīlapīt'ādi-bhedaṃ ārammaṇaṃ vavatthāpento rūpaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti
appaṭisaṃvidite vematiko indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. appaṭisaṃvidite paṭisaṃviditasaññī indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayethā'ti
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethā'ti?

yo ca kho, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yathā vedanīyaṃ ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā'ssa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso hoti, okāso paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

40896.grammar: opt, reflx 3rd sg of paṭisaṃvediyeyya, trans (+acc)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethā'ti?
sādhu khv'assa, bhikkhave, yaṃ idh'ekacco sakyaputtiyapaṭiñño evarūpam'pi attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.

40897.meaning2: who feels, experiences, suffers, or enjoys

examples.text: evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto
sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
sukhañ'ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī'ti
pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharissasi sato ca sampajāno sukhañ'ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedissasi
